content: निर्वाण {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Blown or put out, extinguished (as a lamp or fire); निर्वाणवैरदहनाः प्रशमादरीणाम् <ls>Ve. 1. 7</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 23</ls>. .²2 Lost, disappeared. .²3 Dead, deceased. .²4 Liberated from existence. .²5 Set (as the sun). .²6 Calmed, quieted. .²7 Plunged. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Extinction; अपि निर्वाणमायाति नानलो याति शीतताम् <ls>H. 1. 131</ls>; शनैर्निर्वाणमाप्नोति निरिन्धन इवानलः <ls>Mb.</ls> .²2 Vanishing from sight, disappearance. .²3 Dissolution, death. .²4 Final liberation or emancipation from matter and reunion with the Supreme Spirit, eternal bliss; निर्वाणं नाधिगच्छेयुर्जीवेयुः पशुजीविकाम् <ls>Mb. 3. 31</ls>, <ls n="Mb. 3.">26</ls>; निर्वाणमपि मन्येऽहमन्तरायं जयश्रियः <ls>Ki. 11. 69</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 1</ls>. .²5 (With Buddhists) Absolute extinction or annihilation, complete extinction of individual or worldly existence. .²6 Perfect and perpetual calm, repose; निर्वाणं समुपगमेन यच्छते ते (नमः) <ls>Ki. 18. 39</ls>. .²7 Complete satisfaction or pleasure, supreme bliss, highest felicity; स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति <ls>Bg. 5. 24</ls>; अये लब्धं नेत्रनिर्वाणम् <ls>Ś. 3</ls>; <ls>M. 3. 1</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 23</ls>; <ls>V. 3. 21</ls>. .²8 Cessation, desisting. .²9 Vacuity. .²10 Union, association, confluence. .²11 The bathing of an elephant; as in अनिर्वाण <ls>R. 1. 71</ls>. .²12 Instruction in sciences. .²13 Finis, completion; प्राप्य संकल्पनिर्वाणं नातिप्रीतोऽभ्यगात् पुरम् <ls>Bhāg. 4. 9. 27</ls>.
